entries.en:
Lisette de Valentione and her band of loyal retainers have once again journeyed from Ishgard to bring the passionate spirit of their noble house's motto─ardor and affection─to all Eorzea. However, in their efforts to aid those Eorzeans unable to confess their love in person, the party has met with an unforeseen obstacle that only an experienced adventurer can overcome. Lisette bids you speak with Hortefense, the man spearheading the mission, to learn more.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

entries.en: Hortefense explains how he and his emissaries have been tasked with delivering tokens of love in petitioners' steads. However, while the service was intended to aid those shackled by shyness, they have received requests from another, unexpected source: those who would gladly present their gifts directly, if only they knew where their loved ones were. Hortefense has pledged to locate these absent sweethearts, but as a stranger to these lands, he has thus far met with little success. Hence does he seek the assistance of learned adventurers to find these missing men, and ensure that no love goes unspoken this Valentione's Day.
entries.fr: Hortefense vous a expliqué la situation. En tant que messager de l'amour, il doit parfois retrouver la trace de personnes perdues de vue pour aider des couples à se former, mais ses con<->nais<->san<->ces modestes de la géographie éorzéenne lui posent problème... Offrez-lui votre aide pour faire triompher l'amour et perpétuer la tradition de la Valention.
entries.ja: オルトファンスから話を聞いた。彼らは愛の告白ができないでいる人の手伝いをしているそうだが、告白相手の居場所がわからないことがあるのだという。愛の伝道師の助手として、告白相手の居場所をつきとめ、愛の成就に貢献しよう。

entries.en: For today is Valentione's Day, and once again we of House Valentione come bearing a simple message: ardor and affection for all! Such is the solemn vow of our house, ever since the days of my uncountably great grandmother, the Countess Arabelle, who braved every hardship in a lifelong quest for love!
entries.fr: ... Oui, car comme tous les ans à la même époque, Éorzéa célèbre la Valention, la grande fête de l'amour sous toutes ses formes<nbsp>!

entries.en: So it is that we too have journeyed from our homeland to herald her heroic message. For too long have Eorzean hearts been stifled by the miasmata of apathy and abashment. Ours shall be the wind that dispels these poisonous fogs, and sweeps every shrinking violet into the arms of their beloved!
entries.fr: En tant que descendante directe de l'illustre marquise Arabelle de Valention, dont le courage et la dévotion envers l'élu de son cœur ont inspiré nombre d'amants à travers les âges, je suis venue de la lointaine Ishgard avec mes assistants pour perpétuer la tradition.

「愛」に生きたご先祖サマにあやかってぇ、
私たちは、みんなの「愛」を応援しにぃ、
とおいとお～い、イシュガルドからやってきましたっ♪

entries.en: Or at least, so was the plan. We sought to lend our strength to those unable to confess their feelings in person, yet it seems there are some whose inability stems not from diffidence, but from ignorance. And honestly, how do they expect our arrows of love to find their target, when they themselves cannot?
entries.fr: Seulement, il semblerait que le sort ait décidé de nous empêcher d'accomplir notre mission d'attiser les passions...

だって、アナタなら、きっと「愛」を伝えられると思うから♪

entries.en: Allow me to explain: every year, a delegation led by House Valentione departs from Ishgard to travel the length and breadth of Eorzea, urging the people to air their passions─to confess their true feelings to their beloved with a word of affection, or a sentimental gift of some kind.
entries.fr: Permettez-moi d'abord de vous expliquer la situation. En fait, notre rôle est de donner un petit coup de pouce aux amoureux timides qui ne trouvent pas le courage de faire leur déclaration.
entries.ja:
まずは、事情を説明しようか。
今回、僕が担当しているのは、
「愛の告白ができないでいる人」の手伝いなんだ。

entries.en: Yet there are some who struggle to do such a simple thing, their hearts silenced by shyness. It is to these poor souls that I and my emissaries have come to offer our services. We lubricate the wheels of love, so to speak, by delivering heartfelt missives on a timid suitor's behalf.
entries.fr: En pratique, nous nous occupons de faire parvenir leurs lettres d'amour et leurs cadeaux, ou encore d'arranger les cir<->cons<->tan<->ces afin que leur déclaration soit couronnée de succès.
entries.ja:
具体的には、恋文や贈り物を届けてあげたり、
告白の状況を整えてあげたりしているんだよ。

entries.en: However, there are some who have sought out our services for another reason: they lack not the confidence to confess their love, but merely the knowledge of where their loved ones are. Sworn as we are to bring succor to every pining soul, we have pledged ourselves to their cause.
entries.fr: Mais ce n'est pas tout<nbsp>! Figurez-vous que certaines personnes saisissent même l'occasion de la Valention pour nous demander de retrouver l'être aimé dont elles ont perdu la trace.

中には、告白相手の居場所がわからないまま、
この機会に、想いを伝えたいって人もいてね。

entries.en: Yet I fear we Ishgardians have been cloistered in our own lands too long to be of any use in tracking these missing sweethearts down. We lack the knowledge of Eorzean geography that would allow us to deduce their locations from the scant clues the petitioners can provide.
entries.fr: Le problème, c'est que nos con<->nais<->san<->ces de la région sont relativement limitées, ce qui fait que nous nous retrouvons souvent dans l'impasse... Je suppose que vous voyez où je veux en venir<nbsp>?
